summary: Added and enriched domain knowledge to improve Task Comments feature.

additions.description: The system must ensure that comment lists update in real-time, even when multiple users are commenting on the same task simultaneously.
additions.rationale: Real-time updates enhance collaboration and reduce misunderstandings among team members.

modifications.original_description: Given a comment authored by someone else, the user must not see a delete option for it.
modifications.enhanced_description: Given a comment the user authored, when they choose delete, the system must confirm with the user before permanently removing the comment from the list.
modifications.rationale: This modification ensures that users are aware of and agree to the deletion of their own comments.
